page.layout: One text column of numbered theses, with short references set at the end of several lines. No margin notes, running head, page number or signature. The catchword "At" stands at the right of the last line.

main_text.p: Illam Philosophia THEORETICAM dixêre: hanc PRACTICAM, Moralem, Civilem, Humanam.
Et apud Philosophum, ubi Philosophiæ nomen illa sola sibi ascíscit[?]: nec forsan immeritò. 2. Metaphys.t.3.&1. 4.t.4.

PARTES illius tres esse tuemur, pro triplici τῶν ὄντων[?], Entium seu Rerum considerandarum ratione, tractationis denique earundem conditione triplici. Scientiæ vero sigillatim nomine omnes dignissimæ. 6. Primæ Philos.t.2. & l.11.c.1.1. Phys.1.
In Scientiarum interim ad Substantiarum genera distributionem consensum damus. 4. primæ phil.
Scire, est causam cognoscere, propter quam res est, quòd illius causa sit, & quòd se res illa aliter habere non possit. 1. post. Anal. 2.
De illis igitur συνωνύμως an ὁμωνύμως scientia Theo-retica prædicetur, quæsitum est. Nos utrumq; tuemur. Metaphys. 6. & l.2.t.3. 1.physic.1.
Inter sese si committantur, dignitas Obiecti, META-PHYSICAM in primis ponit. II. Metaph. Sum. 3. c.1.

p.i: De certitudine vero & exinde nata dignitate quæritur, An quæ Obiecti indeq; deductorum firmitas est, ea dictis consentit?

main_text.p: Quæ autem è rationum subtilitate, ἀκριβεία, ac demonstrationum quoq; robore enascitur nobilitas, ea est, quæ MATHEMATICA excellere putatur.

page.notes: The Greek words τῶν ὄντων and ἀκριβεία are read from a small scan and should be checked. ascíscit is uncertain. The numeral "XIIX." is printed that way (an error for XVIII) and is left as printed. The references at line ends (for example "2. Metaphys.t.3.&1.") are set in the column and are transcribed as text, not as margin notes. "Theo-retica" keeps the printed hyphen at the line end.
